description_expanded: ABOUT TIDEWATER 311: Welcome to Tidewater 311 in Panama City Beach, a great 2 bedroom beach front condo that sleeps 8, has ocean and beach views, a community pool and other great resort style amenities and is less than a mile from the famous Pier Park. This great condo resides is in Tidewater Beach Resort which has two gulf front pools, an indoor pool, fitness center and game room all on property. Your private balcony is the perfect spot to enjoy the sights and sounds of the ocean while relaxing with your morning coffee or an evening beverage as the sun calls it a day! Tidewater 311 is a perfect vacation spot for couples or families who want to relax, play, shop, or all three for a long weekend or a much needed week away. Located on the 3rd floor of Tidewater Beach Resort you get a direct view of the Emerald coast waters right from your own private balcony. With a king in the master, a queen in the guest bedroom and a twin hallway bunk, you will find ample space to house all your family members or extra guests. Come escape to Panama City Beach and book your next vacation here today! ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Private Community Beach PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Beach Front Condo * Balcony Views * Community Pool * Fitness center PARKING: * Paid Parking available for $60 per vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * No Pets permitted * There is no smoking inside or outside while on the property. * All reservations are non-refundable, we strongly encourage adding travel insurance to your reservation so that you are covered. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.
